We are Avengers Tech, an ambitious team participating in NASA Space Apps at Zewail City. We specialize in DataScience Libraries, ML, and Multivariable Calculus.

We are tackling the Flame in Freefall challenge to build a smart AI-powered fire-safety system for microgravity space missions.

I'm Abdulrahman AI/Machine Learning and Software Engineer.
